games.blurb: You are a giant alien, dropped into a city by your mothership. Climb the towers, punch them till they fall, and swat the army that fights back.
games.picture: A spiky teal alien walks towards three tower blocks, with soldiers at the windows, on a city street at dusk.

games.blurb: Fly through waves of enemies, grab power capsules and charge a Nova burst. At the end of each stage, shoot the Warden's eye while its jaws are open.
games.picture: A silver ship fires at a line of red one-eyed enemies, with a striped orange planet behind.

games.blurb: Steer a chrome chomper round five mazes, eat every light and keep clear of four gremlins. The big orbs turn the tables for a few seconds.
games.picture: A purple maze full of lights, with a chrome chomper and three red gremlins.

games.blurb: A fleet of invaders marches down the sky. Slide along the ground, shoot them all before they land, and use the bunkers for cover.
games.picture: Rows of red and amber invaders above four grey bunkers and a ship on a purple planet.

games.blurb: Hop a chrome frog over roads, rails and rivers to the lily pads, past trams, steam trains and diving turtles, in town and country.
games.picture: A frog in the road between cars and trucks, with logs on the river and lily pads beyond.

games.blurb: Bounce the ball off your paddle and smash the wall of bricks against the sunset. Each level brings armoured bricks, new shapes and a faster ball.
games.picture: A wall of red, orange and amber bricks above a glowing ball, a chrome paddle and a setting sun behind mountains.
